title: Department budget share
prompt: Return department, budget, and pct_of_total — each department's budget expressed as a percentage (0-100) of the total budget across all departments, rounded to 2 decimal places. Compute the total using a window SUM() OVER () with no PARTITION BY.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE dept_budget (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, department TEXT, budget REAL); INSERT INTO dept_budget VALUES (1,'Engineering',500000.0),(2,'Sales',300000.0),(3,'Marketing',150000.0),(4,'HR',50000.0);
reference_sql: SELECT department, budget, ROUND(100.0 * budget / SUM(budget) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total FROM dept_budget;
